planning_notes: The request for 5 MEDIUM difficulty targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the available 10. To ensure non-redundancy and depth, each target utilizes a unique pedagogical facet: Concept Understanding for the core VAE mechanism, Theoretical Rationale for the KL divergence component, Code Interpretation for the reparameterization trick implementation, Parameter Change for encoder architecture dimensions, and Practical Application for the Fashion-MNIST context. This covers the theoretical, mathematical, implementation, and application layers of the lecture content.
